name: How does AKN Design Group handle unexpected issues during a garage addition project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle unexpected issues during a garage addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group handles unexpected issues during a garage addition project through clear communication and a proactive, managed process. With over two decades in business and 10,000+ jobs completed, we bring extensive experience to anticipate and mitigate potential challenges. Should an unforeseen condition arise, such as discovering undocumented utilities or unforeseen soil conditions, we immediately communicate with the homeowner, explain the situation, and propose solutions, including any necessary adjustments to the timeline or budget. Our commitment to reliability means we address issues efficiently to keep the project on track and maintain trust.
acceptedAnswer.description: We handle unexpected project issues with clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and our extensive experience to propose solutions and maintain project progress.
